title: Personal Training Packages: the per-package habitual late-cancellation surcharge
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the habitual late-cancellation surcharge is administered when a late cancellation is being logged against a specific package.

## Rule
Here the habitual count is administered per package rather than pooled across every package the member holds, so that each package's own prior late-cancellation history alone decides whether that package's habitual surcharge has begun. Once a package has already accumulated the tier's own habitual-cancellation cutoff count or more prior late cancellations recorded against that same package, this and every further late cancellation logged against that package additionally incurs the tier's own habitual surcharge amount on top of the ordinary late-cancellation charge. Where the running count of prior late cancellations recorded against that same package is still below the cutoff count, no surcharge is added and only the ordinary late-cancellation charge (net of any corporate wellness reduction) is charged.

## Points of judgement
- Count only this package's own history: a member's late cancellations logged against a different package the member also holds are never added to this package's running count.
- If the running count of prior late cancellations already recorded against this same package, plus the one now being logged, reaches or exceeds the tier's own cutoff count, the surcharge is added.
- If that running count, plus the one now being logged, remains below the cutoff count, no surcharge is added.
As a boundary illustration: a package whose prior late-cancellation count on that same package, once this one is added, exactly reaches the tier's own cutoff count is already over the line, so the surcharge applies to this cancellation and to every further one logged against that package; a package whose count, once this one is added, remains one short of the cutoff count is not yet over the line, so no surcharge applies to this cancellation.
